summary: iTonic Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a 180-day extension from Nasdaq, until October 19, 2026, to regain compliance with the minimum bid price rule (NASDAQ Listing Rule 5550(a)(2)). No specific price, premium, or shareholder vote is involved. The extension is a routine regulatory compliance notice, not a structural corporate event or special situation. The company may face delisting if non-compliance persists after the deadline, but the filing itself is not an event-driven special situation.
